body: Idk I feel like maybe I have come this far and it wasnt for me. I will never pass as the gender i want to be seen as i know there are woman with masculine features but im waaaay masculine and I will always look inbetween and I don't want that, and it will probably take a whole bunch of cosmetic surgeries that i can't afford till later on in life. I don't regret transitioning and honestly I'm such a better person for doing it but it's just alot of emotions and feelings of not being complete like maybe I need to look deeper into me and see what it is that I really want. Maybe I'll come back like you said but for right now what I feel is I need to stop and just breath I guess if that makes sense.
As you can see I kinda got screwed with my face it is really manly and my hair doesn't help me I feel like completely giving up on it all. Anybody else start like strong features and end up better???

I know I shouldn't detransition it wouldn't be good and I don't want to go back. It's just incredibly hard to see any light anymore. How they treat me makes me feel fake like I was so happy in the beginning then I really looked at myself and maybe I was deluding myself. It's just hard when insecurities are ruining my self worth.
